header: Numbered notes at the foot of an article
note: The block's own note sits under the list, for anything that applies to every source rather than to one of them.

notes.title: The marker is the note's position in an ordered list, not a number stored on the row.
notes.description: Reordering the rows renumbers the markers, which is what inserting a source in the middle of an article has to do.

notes.title: Each note carries an id, so a superscript in the prose above can link straight to it.
notes.description: The note it lands on is highlighted, because the browser gives no other indication of where the jump ended.

notes.title: A link is optional and takes the whole URL as its text.
notes.description: Printed in full so the reference survives being printed on paper.
